Notes From the Workshop

The workshop ran for two days and covered tooling, testing, and release practices. Attendees brought their own projects and worked through problems in small groups.

The first day focused on setting up a reproducible build.
The second day covered writing tests that fail before a fix.
Everyone left with a checklist for their next release.
Before the break.
Figure 1 shows the planning board.
After the break.

Most groups finished early and spent the remaining time reviewing each other's changes, which turned out to be the most useful part of the event.
